value.rationale: The map was introduced and studied for bifurcations and complex parameter-dependent behavior, so a whole-space analytic convergence region is a motivated structural gap. The theorem rules out all nontrivial recurrence for any initial data on the closed region; endpoint rigidity is nontrivial and the natural gradient-potential sharp threshold has a specific dynamical meaning. Complete four-versus-six fixed limit states sharpen the global picture. These are not arbitrary numerical slices or routine reparametrizations of previously known same-model conclusions.
